verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a companion client for GitHub's hosted service (reviewing PRs, triaging issues, managing Copilot agent tasks). It is not a remote-connection tool that keeps a list of saved hosts and connection profiles. The evidence pack shows no host or connection-profile management, so the story's axis does not apply to this product type.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sync my saved hosts and connection settings across all my devices
